label: The pre-commit header's uninstall command can leave the active hook installed when core.hooksPath is customized: it directs users to remove .git/hooks/pre-commit, but the installer resolves the active directory through Git and its --uninstall option removes links there. The canonical README warns that global core.hooksPath can shadow .git/hooks and directs users to --uninstall.
